[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 240
- Description: SKU record + 42 serialized QR codes — Oscar's Farm 81% Cacao 50g bar (batch 9e969d3f)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/lineage-assets/commit/f33b7ddaf7b5a47ac009219580b4523b5795964b
  
  Details:
  Created the new SKU/currency record and serialized 42 QR codes for the 81% Cacao Chocolate Bar 50g batch repackaged by Kirsten Ritschel on 2026-11-04 (Oscar's Farm, Bahia, Brazil, 2024 harvest).
  
  WORK COMPLETED
  
  1. SKU / currency record created
  - Repackaging batch event submitted & signature-verified; GAS processor created the Currencies row.
  - Request ID 9e969d3f-8cd9-40a1-b456-3a8a7189adc2
  - Currency: "Agroverse 81% Cacao Chocolate Bar 50g | Oscar Cacao Nibs | Kirsten 20261104 | San Francisco - MAIN"
  - 42 units x 50 g = 2,100 g output; 1,910 g cacao input (1,810 g nibs + 100 g butter)
  - Line total $113.74902; unit cost $2.70831/bar; cost per gram $0.054166
  - Inputs: 8 x 8oz Ilheus pouch ($84.08), 0.1 kg Coopercabruca butter ($3.44), 42 Joyberg envelopes ($2.961), 42 Sticker Mule labels ($23.268)
  - Cols N (raw request) and O (composition JSON) populated automatically.
  - Composition record: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agroverse-inventory/blob/main/currency-compositions/9e969d3f-8cd9-40a1-b456-3a8a7189adc2.json
  
  2. Metadata backfill (cols C-M) — required to make the row QR-ready
  - CURRENCY DEFINITION EVENT was submitted and signature-verified but silently no-opped: the GAS handler `process_currency_definitions_telegram_logs.js` is insert-only (currencyDefinitionRecordExists -> true -> marks row complete, never writes C-M). Since the repackaging batch had already created the row, no supported event could fill the metadata cells.
  - Diagnosed the root cause by reading the GAS source, then backfilled cols C-M from the 20261027 precedent row of the same farm (Serializable=TRUE, product image, landing page, ledger gid=17, Oscar's Farm / Bahia / Brazil / 2024, unit weight 50, SKU organic-81-dark-chocolate-bar-50g-oscar-bahia-2024), locating the row by name because the tab re-sorts on insert.
  
  3. 42 QR codes generated and published
  - BATCH QR CODE REQUEST submitted & signature-verified; all 42 serials 2024_20261104_1 ... _42 confirmed MINTED.
  - 42 compiled print-ready labels built and each one verified against Edgar's qr-code-check endpoint (42/42 pass).
  - 84 files pushed to lineage-assets: 42 compiled labels + 42 lineage manifests.
  - Commit: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/lineage-assets/commit/f33b7ddaf7b5a47ac009219580b4523b5795964b
  - Raw QR PNGs and manifests already auto-committed by the QR batch workflow.
  
  PUBLIC ARTIFACTS
  - Compiled labels: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TrueSightDAO/lineage-assets/main/pngs/compiled_Oscar_s_Farm_2024_20261104_1.png (through _42)
  - Raw QR PNGs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TrueSightDAO/lineage-assets/main/pngs/2024_20261104_1.png (through _42)
  - Manifests: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TrueSightDAO/lineage-assets/main/qrs/2024_20261104_1.json (through _42)
  - Verification page: https://edgar.truesight.me/agroverse/qr-code-check?qr_code=2024_20261104_1
  
  TIME BREAKDOWN (240 minutes)
  - Cost basis research, SKU verification against live treasury-cache, payload build & signing, submit + verify: 75 min
  - Root-causing the silent currency-definition no-op (GAS source read) and backfilling cols C-M to QR-ready: 75 min
  - QR batch request, verifying 42 mints, compiling 42 labels, per-QR verification: 60 min
  - Publishing 84 files to lineage-assets, URL verification, zip packaging & delivery: 30 min
  
  TOOLING GAP FOUND (not yet fixed)
  process_currency_definitions_telegram_logs.js should upsert C-M when the row exists but is blank. Currently a repackaging batch followed by a definition event requires a manual sheet write.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 400.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
